definition: Modin is a drop-in replacement for pandas that spreads DataFrame work across all your CPU cores.
details: Started at UC Berkeley RISELab by Devin Petersohn and colleagues; later developed with Ponder and Snowflake.

explainer.lead: How to install Modin, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Created at UC Berkeley RISELab (Devin Petersohn et al.).

quickstart.python:
import modin.pandas as pd   # the only line that changes

df = pd.read_csv("large.csv")
print(df.describe())

explainer.inAi: Speed up existing pandas feature pipelines with a one-line import change.
explainer.jsNote: Modin is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
